page.overview:
Who is Blue Five?

"Blue Five" was a woman and a Mirialan. As a pilot for the Resistance Starfighter Corps' Blue Squadron, she helmed a T-70 X-wing starfighter. On her final mission, she flew as part of a wing guard for a Resistance recruitment transport leaving from Black Spire Outpost on Batuu for the primary Resistance base.

Blue Five joined the Resistance before 34 ABY and flew as a starfighter pilot as a part of Blue Squadron under Captain Temmin Wexley. When the First Order attacked the Resistance base on D'Qar in 34 ABY, Blue Five was away on a mission and one of the few surviving members of Blue Squadron; Kylo Ren's bombing run killed most of the squadron before they could deploy.

Under orders from General Leia Organa Solo to grow the Resistance, Blue Five joined other revolutionaries on Batuu a few months later to regroup and rebuild. There, she acted as air support should any First Order TIE fighters attack their hidden base. Later that year, Vi Moradi drummed up enough new recruits that local command decided to fly the group to General Organa's secret base on Pacara. Blue Five joined the mission with Red Two to escort an Intersystem Transport Ship carrying the new volunteers. The three ships along with Commander Poe Dameron in the lead took off from the Black Spire Ruins and flew into orbit.

Before they could escape through Hyperspace, their group was attacked by a flurry of TIE fighters launched from two Resurgent-class Star Destroyers hidden in orbit, including Kylo Ren's personal flagship, the Finalizer. She leapt into action, gunning down a few TIEs as she twisted through Batuu's asteroid field; however, they were quickly overwhelmed, and the TIEs shot down her wingmate, Red Two. Blue Five took evasive action, but there were too many of them. She died defending the transport when her fighter was destroyed.
